title: Password Hint Guard
summary: Spots the password inside a password hint or security answer, even reversed, spaced out or in leetspeak, without ever showing the password.
description: Hint or security-answer field that spots the password inside it (also backwards, spaced out or in leetspeak), a large piece of it, or a "same as my bank" reuse admission, without displaying the password, and removes the leak in one tap.
catches: The password written in the hint
A long shared substring of the password
Admissions of reuse such as "same as my bank"
limits: Compares only with the password in the same form
Can't catch hints that describe the password indirectly ("my dog's name")
a11y: Visible label; input has aria-invalid for a severe leak and is described by a polite status
server: Don't store hints next to passwords, and run the same check on the server if hints are kept.
